subject: SIG kickoff: custom prefill & field-mapping clarifications for PHI scope
summary: Post-demo follow-up: confirm SOC 2 / HIPAA / GDPR scope, initiate SIG prefill vs CAIQ mapping, request list of PHI-containing fields and encryption requirements, schedule technical follow-up with security engineer.
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@arbormed.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@arbormed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:12:00Z
Subject: Quick recap + SIG kickoff asks — Redwood <> ArborMed

Thanks again for taking time today — good discussion. Short recap and suggested next steps to keep the security intake moving: 

- Scope recap from call:
  • SOC 2: you indicated a Type II audit is underway (target completion Q3 2027) — please confirm auditor and expected report date.
  • HIPAA: ArborMed is operating as a covered entity / BAA applies — we will treat patient data as PHI for scope.
  • GDPR: you have EU subsidiaries that ingest person data — we should mark EU processing as in scope.

- SIG / CAIQ path: Redwood can share a CAIQ prefill (we maintain a CAIQ/OSCAL mapping) but if you prefer a custom SIG template we can map answers into your form. To get started, could you send either a prefilled SIG file or a short list of the specific fields you care most about (e.g., patient_id, mrn, notes, imaging_url)?

- Evidence & controls: please indicate which controls require field-level encryption (beyond standard at-rest AES), and whether you need BYOK/KMS integration or if provider-managed keys are acceptable.

- Logistics: I attached a one-page intake checklist (redwood_sig_prefill_v0.3.pdf) and a notes doc; additionally I can upload a lightweight evidence map template if helpful. Proposed next step: you share a prefill or a list of PHI fields by EOD Wed 4/21, then we schedule a 30-min security working session (include your security engineer) next week. 

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill_v0.3.pdf (template), call recording (link in HubSpot).

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@arbormed.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@arbormed.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick recap + SIG kickoff asks — Redwood <> ArborMed

Marcus — thanks for the clear notes. Confirmations and context below: 

- SOC 2: Yes, Type II in flight; auditor is NorthStar Audit; estimated report delivery 2027-09-15.
- HIPAA: Correct — ArborMed handles PHI and will require a BAA.
- GDPR: EU subsidiaries (Spain & Ireland) process patient-identifiable data; we will need controls mapped for EU processing.

A few clarifying Qs before we complete the prefill: 
1) Can Redwood accept a mixed submission: our teams can supply a CSV of field names + classification and a separate security questionnaire (PDF/Excel) for answers?
2) Does Redwood support field-level encryption or tokenization for specific columns (e.g., MRN, SSN)? If yes, can you outline options (provider-managed keys vs BYOK)?
3) For audit logs: what's Redwood's default retention for token-level logs (and can it be extended to 7 years if contractually required)?

I've attached a short context pack to help your team map controls (ArborMed_SIG_Context.pdf). We're drafting a prefill but need your guidance on the expected column names and any evidence naming conventions.

We'll aim to send an initial prefill by EOD Thursday 4/22. Please confirm whether a SIG Lite or full CAIQ is preferred — our security team has a slight preference for SIG Lite for speed.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Security Operations, ArborMed
elena.ruiz@arbormed.com
+1 (650) 555-0142

Attachments: ArborMed_SIG_Context.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@arbormed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick recap + SIG kickoff asks — Redwood <> ArborMed

Elena — great, thanks for that context and the fast turnaround. Quick answers and a short ask list so your prefill aligns with our evidence map: 

- Submission format: CSV of field names + classification is perfect. We'll map it to our internal CAIQ/OSCAl view and then generate the answers into your requested template.

- Field-level encryption: Redwood supports two options:
  1) Provider-managed envelope encryption (AES-256 at rest) for all stored artifacts (default).
  2) BYOK via customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault) for key wrapping — this supports field-level encryption where you can provide keys and we rotate per your policy.

- Audit logs retention: default 90 days for token-level detail; we can extend to 7 years under an enterprise retention addendum (contractual).

Concrete asks to make our prefill accurate: 
1) CSV of fields with a column for "contains_phi" (yes/no) and another for "sensitivity_label" (high/medium/low).
2) Example event or flow that includes PHI (e.g., ingestion pipeline: API -> queue -> model inference -> storage) so we can map controls per data path.
3) Any existing control IDs you want mapped to (e.g., SOC 2 CCs, NIST 800-53).

I've attached our prefill template (redwood_sig_prefill_v0.3.pdf) and an evidence-map stub. Once you send the CSV, Karthik or Monica will map answers and we can produce both a SIG Lite prefill and a full CAIQ export — whichever you prefer. If you want BYOK details, Monica can run a short technical call to walk through KMS binding and key policies.

Next step: Elena, can you confirm whether you want SIG Lite first (faster) or full CAIQ up front? Also who from your security team should be on a 30-min call next week (we have availability Tue/Wed afternoon PT).

Thanks,
Marcus

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill_v0.3.pdf

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@arbormed.com>

Marcus / team — attaching our initial prefill and a data-classification export. We started with a SIG Lite preference to move quickly; please map into your CAIQ view and return both the SIG Lite prefill (completed) and a CAIQ export if possible.

Attachments:
- ArborMed_SIG_Prefill_Answers.xlsx (CSV-style sheet with field list, contains_phi, sensitivity_label)
- data_classification_matrix.csv

We can do Tue 4/27 at 2:00 PM PT for the tech handoff; I'll invite our security engineer (Rajiv) plus one architect. For BYOK — we will likely require BYOK for the most sensitive fields, so please prepare a short BYOK/tech integration primer for that call (Karthik / Monica).

Elena

ArborMed notes: We redacted internal bucket names in the CSV; we can provide sanitized examples during the call.
